events.seoDescription: Discover cultural, educational and community events organized and supported by Alianza Ecuatoriana Internacional.
events.heroIntro: Our events celebrate heritage, create connections and bring Ecuadorian and Latino communities together across generations.
events.heroPhotoAlt: Ecuadorian community members taking part in a cultural parade.
events.featurePhotoAlt: Participants carrying Ecuadorian and international flags during a community parade.
events.featureCopy1: Cultural parades bring neighbors together to share Ecuadorian heritage and celebrate the many communities that make New York home.
events.featureCopy2: These public gatherings create welcoming opportunities to share traditions, connect across generations and build community.

moment.celebrationsCopy: AEINY participates in and supports Ecuadorian community gatherings and parade activities in Queens, strengthening connections across the wider Latino community.
moment.celebrationsPhotoAlt: Families and community members celebrating together at an AEINY gathering.
moment.gatheringsCopy: Community gatherings make room for neighbors to connect, share experiences and strengthen local ties.
moment.gatheringsPhotoAlt: Community members gathered together at an AEINY community event.
moment.generationsCopy: Cultural gatherings help traditions travel across borders and give younger generations a way to stay connected with Ecuadorian identity.
moment.generationsPhotoAlt: Community members sharing a meal at an AEINY gathering.

events.filmTitle: 1st International Andean Film Festival New York 2026
events.filmCopy: The Andes International Film Fest New York celebrates Andean cinema, identity and cultural heritage in New York.
events.socialCopy: Follow Alianza Ecuatoriana Internacional on Facebook for the latest community events, announcements and activities.

eventKuri2023.title: Kuri Chasqui 2023
eventKuri2023.intro: A previous festival edition centered on Andean culture, cinema, and community connection.
eventKuri2023.copy: This page is a placeholder for a previous edition of the festival, with the foundation for future event storytelling and archival content.
